tasks.title: Slow nav hover expand with smooth CSS transitions
tasks.description: Hover was snapping height/padding instantly because only color properties were transitioned. Move hover styles into custom.css and animate height, padding, letter-spacing, and colors over ~0.7s ease-in-out.
tasks.details: Removed instant hover height jumps from header.html inline styles; custom.css now owns base + hover with 0.7s ease-in-out.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria:
Nav link hover expands height and letter-spacing smoothly without a snap
Mobile collapse open/close feels slower than Bootstrap default
header.html no longer applies instant hover height jumps

tasks.title: Slow mobile navbar collapse open/close
tasks.description: Override Bootstrap .collapsing 0.35s height transition with a longer ease-in-out duration so the hamburger menu open/close feels smoother.
tasks.details: Set .navbar-collapse.collapsing and .collapsing to height 0.85s ease-in-out with !important to beat Bootstrap.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Hamburger menu open and close uses ~0.85s ease-in-out height transition
